question: Which Indian cricketer was inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The legendary former **Indian captain** and wicket-keeper batsman, **MS Dhoni**, was inducted into the **ICC Hall of Fame** in **June 2025**.
 
• He is celebrated for his unparalleled leadership, having led **India** to victory in three major **ICC** tournaments: the **2007 T20 World Cup**, the **2011 ODI World Cup**, and the **2013 Champions Trophy**.
 
• The **ICC Hall of Fame** recognizes the achievements of the legends of the game of cricket, and **Dhoni** is one of the few **Indian** players to receive this prestigious honor.
 
• Known as "**Captain Cool**" for his composure under pressure, **Dhoni** redefined the role of a finisher in limited-overs cricket and remains the only captain in history to win all three **ICC** limited-overs trophies.
 
• His induction in **2025** follows the **ICC** guideline that typically requires a player to be retired from international cricket for at least **five years** before becoming eligible for the **Hall of Fame**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ICC Hall of Fame:**
 
 
• It was launched by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)** in **January 2009** to honor the sport's greatest players throughout history.
 
• The initiative was started in collaboration with the **Federation of International Cricketers' Associations (FICA)** as part of the **ICC's centenary celebrations**.
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni's Career Highlights:**
 
 
• **Dhoni** made his international debut in **2004** against **Bangladesh** and announced his retirement from international cricket on **August 15, 2020**.
 
• In **350 ODIs**, he scored **10,773 runs** at an average of **50.57**, and he holds the record for the most stumpings (**123**) in **ODI** history.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in **2018**, the **Padma Shri** in **2009**, and India's highest sporting honor, the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna**, in **2007**.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Indian Inductees:**
 
 
• Before **MS Dhoni**, other **Indian** legends inducted into the **ICC Hall of Fame** include **Bishan Singh Bedi**, **Kapil Dev**, **Sunil Gavaskar** (**2009**), **Anil Kumble** (**2015**), **Rahul Dravid** (**2018**), **Sachin Tendulkar** (**2019**), and **Virender Sehwag** (**2023**).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sachin Tendulkar:** Often referred to as the "**Master Blaster**," he was inducted into the **Hall of Fame** in **2019**. He is the all-time highest run-scorer in **Test** and **ODI** cricket.
 
• **Virat Kohli:** While one of the greatest modern batsmen, **Kohli** is still active or has recently moved towards the end of his career; induction usually follows a specific **post-retirement period** of **five years**.
 
• **Sourav Ganguly:** Known as "**Dada**," **Ganguly** was instrumental in building the **Indian** team in the early **2000s** and served as the **President** of the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** from **2019** to **2022**.
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:** To be considered for the **ICC Hall of Fame**, a player must have a significant impact on the game and have played their last international match at least **five years** prior to the induction year.
